notes: Synthetic: authored from Cerebras' official SDK, github.com/Cerebras/cerebras-cloud-sdk-python at cacaf75 (2026-07-08), whose types Stainless generates from Cerebras' spec (the spec itself is not public): types/chat/chat_completion.py: ChatCompletionResponse (system_fingerprint, service_tier, time_info, usage with image_tokens and token details), message.reasoning, finish_reason stop / length / content_filter / tool_calls, ChatChunkResponse (delta.reasoning, delta.tokens), and ErrorChunkResponse {error {id, code, message, param, type}, status_code} for a failure mid-stream. The model is the one the SDK README uses. inference-docs.cerebras.ai was not reachable from the authoring sandbox. Top-level time_info and usage.image_tokens reach the client through Extra. completions_text drives TextCompletion (POST /v1/completions, api.md and resources/completions.py of the same SDK): the README's completions example request verbatim (prompt "It was a dark and stormy ", max_tokens 100, model gpt-oss-120b) and types/completion.py CompletionResponse (id, choices[] {index, finish_reason stop|length|content_filter|tool_calls, logprobs, text, tokens}, created, model, object "text_completion", system_fingerprint, time_info, usage), with no response example: the id, timestamps, text and counts are placeholders. The gateway never streams /v1/completions upstream (TextCompletion sets stream false), so there is no stream case. list_models drives ListModels (GET /v1/models, resources/models.py): the default variant of types/model_list_response.py ModelListResponse, ModelMetadataList {data[] {id, created, object "model", owned_by}, object "list"} (the OpenRouter and Hugging Face variants need a format query the gateway never sends), with placeholder values, filed here because the request names no model. No error cases: the SDK types no error body (_client.py _make_status_error reads an optional status_code alone) and no Cerebras source gives one.
